• Mandatory keys: Client, Project, Environment, Owner, CostCenter,
- Environment: dev, qa, pdn, shared (ASM-006, ASM-063)
- CostCenter: farms, drones, collection-centers, trips, shared (ASM-064)
• Capitalization enforced for Client, Project, Owner, FarmId, Name

g.text: SERVICE CONTROL POLICIES (SCPs | Attached to Root & OUs)
3. Protect audit trail & S3 archive (Root: deny trail/lock/kms tampering)
4. Deny long-term IAM credentials (Root: deny iam:CreateUser/Key) [ADR-003]
5. Deny member root users (Root: centralized root credential denial)
6. Require cost tags on creation (Workloads OU: aws:RequestTag)
7. Pipeline-only production changes (Production OU: deny human write in pdn)

g.text: Shared Resource Usage-Based Cost Allocation Formula (ASM-065)
• Scope: Shared managed services without native sub-resource tagging:
- AWS IoT Core message broker and topic rule evaluations
- Amazon Data Firehose cross-account audit ingestion stream
- Amazon CloudWatch centralized audit log groups
• Metric: Stored operation counts per CostCenter reported to monthly billing audit
• Implementation: AWS Cost Categories map CostCenter tags to line items
• Verification: Prorating verified against consolidated billing invoices (ASM-065)

g.text: • [D02] S3 State Buckets: One per environment with S3 native locking
(State bucket (pdn), State bucket (qa), State bucket (dev); ADR-003)
• [D03] Transversal Configuration: common_tags and secrets management
• [D04] Network & VPC: Boundaries, subnets, TGW hub and VPC endpoints (pdn, qa, dev)
• [D06] Identity & KMS: Identity Center, Cognito pools, GitHub OIDC, KMS keys
• [D09] Telemetry Ingestion: IoT Core certificates, topic rules, DynamoDB store
Traceability Contract: All diagram components correspond exactly to IaC modules
in B01-B13 and architectural decisions recorded in docs/decision-log.md.
